verdict.rationale: Retell's custom-telephony docs describe integrating with your own telephony provider through elastic SIP trunking, or by importing numbers from Twilio, Telnyx and Vonage. The setup flow is documented: set up a SIP trunk, point the number at it, and import it into Retell. Imported numbers are also used by other features such as Send SMS, so you are not locked to bundled telephony. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed evidence on PBX-specific configuration (authentication, inbound/outbound routing details).

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can connect my own carrier or PBX via SIP trunking (or import Twilio/Telnyx numbers) instead of being locked to bundled telephony

citations.quote: Integrate Retell voice agents with your own telephony provider using elastic SIP trunking or imported numbers from Twilio, Telnyx, and Vonage.
You set up a SIP trunk, configure your number to point to it, and import that number to Retell.
This guide shows how to integrate Retell agents with your telephony provider and use your own numbers.
